0.original: The Dotharli warrior wants to see just how capable you are.

2.original: Head for the Dusk Throne without straying from the designated path.

4.original: Present the small leather sack to the Dotharli warrior.

26.original: Head for the Dusk Throne without straying from the designated path.

28.original: Present the small leather sack to the Dotharli warrior.

48.original: You are a <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03> that has danced with death many a time. I can tell from your eyes.

49.original: We Dotharl respect all skilled warriors equally. Race does not come into it. I would very much like to witness your strength firsthand.

50.original: Should you be willing, I would have you participate in a trial. It should be no trouble for you─it is a test made for our tribe's youngest. You simply need head to the Dusk Throne and collect a small package.

51.original: Speak with me if you feel up to the challenge.

52.original: Ready to test your might? Head for the Dusk Throne's chest and bring back the sack I have placed there.

53.original: Deviate from the path and you shall fail the trial. You may attempt the test as many times as you like.

54.original: Head for the goal, taking care not to step outside of the designated path. Riding on a mount shall also cause you to fail the trial. Talk with the Dotharli warrior if you wish to reattempt the test.

55.original: Do not lose heart. You may attempt the trial as many times as you wish.

56.original: Do you have the sack? Only it can serve as proof that you have passed the test.

57.original: Do you have the sack? Only it can serve as proof that you have passed the test.

58.original: Skillfully done. Let us return to Dotharl Khaa.

59.original: The trial tests participants' bravery and their ability to cope with unforeseen obstacles. As I expected, it did not trouble you in the slightest.

60.original: Dotharl who complete the trial receive no rewards, but as you are an outsider, I will make an exception.

61.original: I shall not forget you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. You will always be welcome in Dotharl Khaa.
